Humble Huang
While the
has soared in recent years alongside the soaring stock price of Nvidia, the CEO and co-founder wouldn’t know it on most days.
That’s because Huang sometimes doesn’t even look at the Nvidia stock price.
"Not every day, sometimes I’ll look at the end of the day," Huang revealed on CNBC’s "Squawk Box" in October 2024 when asked about whether he looks at his company’s stock price every day.
Huang was also asked if looking at Nvidia’s stock price impacts how good or bad he feels.
"No," Huang quickly answered.
During the unscheduled appearance on CNBC, the anchors called Nvidia "arguably the most successful company in America today," referencing the company’s rising market capitalization.
Nvidia

It took the company less than nine months to reach a $2 trillion market capitalization after passing the $1 trillion milestone. Nvidia took even less time to go from $2 trillion to $3 trillion, hitting the milestone in 96 days and setting a new record for the short time between the two milestones.
Now the world’s most valuable company, Nvidia is worth over $5 trillion.
During the CNBC interview, Huang brushed off the notion that Nvidia’s rising market capitalization was an overnight success.
"32 years," Huang said when the anchors discussed the milestones hit by Nvidia.

What’s Next for Nvidia
Nvidia recently reported second-quarter financial results that beat analyst estimates.

The company also provided early unofficial fiscal 2028 guidance with revenue expected to be up 70% year-over-year. Nvidia management said revenue would be forecasted to rise by more than 100% year-over-year in fiscal 2028 if not for supply constraints.
When it comes to large technology companies, it still amazes analysts and industry experts that Nvidia can continue to post such high year-over-year revenue gains quarter after quarter.
Nvidia continues to power the AI sector and be a leader among hyperscalers, data centers and other areas seeing the fastest growth.
While Huang isn’t checking the Nvidia stock price daily, many investors are.
